description: Harmonic distortion by superimposing time-compressed copies of each wavecycle onto itself: a harmonics datafile lists harmonic_number/amplitude pairs (source amplitude = 1.0) and each cycle gets those partials stamped on at cycle rate, i.e. genuine wavecycle-locked additive overdrive. Duration static and SAMPLE-EXACT (88200/44100 frames on tones and flat noise). Harmonic numbers CDP-enforced 2-1024 ('Error in harmonics file - harmonic number [1030] out of range 2 - 1024' verbatim). No time-variable parameters (pre_attenuation refuses breakpoints, 'Cannot read parameter 1'); the harmonics file is fixed for the run. Deterministic. MONO only.
musical_use: A waveshaper with an exact recipe: add '2 0.5' for octave-up warmth, '3 0.3' for a hollow clarinet-ish edge, stack many high odd harmonics for buzzy transistor grit. Because the partials ride each wavecycle, pitched sources stay perfectly in tune with themselves - it reads as timbre change, not added tones; on noise it simply brightens and hardens the texture. pre_attenuation tames sources that would clip once partials stack (output peaked 0.73 from a 0.5 tone with '2 0.5/3 0.3'). Write the harmonics file with write_data_file(): one 'harmonic amplitude' pair per line. For dynamic spectral evolution chain several renders or use filter-bank recolouring downstream.

harmonics_file.description: REQUIRED datafile of harmonic_number/amplitude pairs, one pair per line (e.g. '2 0.5'); source amplitude is 1.0, harmonic numbers 2-1024 (out-of-range refused verbatim). Positional, after the output slot. Write with write_data_file(); any extension except .brk.

pre_attenuation.description: Gain applied to the input before processing (verified: -p0.5 halves the output peak exactly, 0.3652 vs 0.7304). Use to leave headroom for stacked partials. Scalar only: breakpoint refused 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [pa.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'

examples.description: Octave-up warmth plus a whiff of twelfth.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('harm.txt', '2 0.5\n3 0.3\n'). Same-length output, noticeably richer; peak rises ~1.5x so consider pre_attenuation 0.6.

examples.description: Buzzy odd-harmonic grit with headroom protection.
examples.expected_use:
write_data_file('harmodd.txt', '3 0.4
5 0.3
7 0.25
9 0.2
'). Hollow, clipped-transistor color on pitched material.

known_issues: Unipolar / zero-crossing-free material refused with a two-stage message: 'WARNING: Program assumes maximum wavelength is 0.500000 secs. / WARNING: Wavelength too long at infile time 0.000000 secs. / ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK:' (exit 255).
Stereo refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255) -> mono.
Deterministic (repeat runs byte-identical); no time-variable parameter anywhere - for evolving harmonic content, render several versions and crossfade.
Output level grows with the summed harmonic amplitudes; the program does not normalize (0.5 tone -> 0.73 peak with 0.8 total added amplitude).
